description: This file defines the AppSetupUtility class responsible for handling various setup tasks during the installation or upgrade process of the OrangeHRM application. It includes methods for database creation and connection, configuration insertion, migration execution, and utility functions related to system setup.

classes.name: AppSetupUtility
classes.description: Provides utility functions for setting up and migrating the OrangeHRM system, including database management, configuration insertion, migration execution, and utility operations such as key generation and cleanup.

methods.name: getConfigHelper
methods.description: Returns an instance of ConfigHelper, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getSystemConfiguration
methods.description: Returns the SystemConfiguration instance used for system-specific configurations.

methods.name: getMigrationHelper
methods.description: Returns an instance of MigrationHelper, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: createNewDatabase
methods.description: Creates a new database schema with the given name.

methods.name: connectToDatabaseServer
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the database server without selecting a specific database.

methods.name: isDatabaseExist
methods.description: Checks if a database with the specified name exists.

methods.name: isDatabaseUserExist
methods.description: Checks if a specific database user exists in the MySQL user table.

methods.name: connectToDatabase
methods.description: Establishes a connection to an existing database.

methods.name: isExistingDatabaseEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the connected database contains any tables.

methods.name: createDatabase
methods.description: Creates a database based on the installation type (new or existing) and existing state.

methods.name: insertSystemConfiguration
methods.description: Inserts various system configuration data into the database.

methods.name: insertCsrfKey
methods.description: Generates and stores a CSRF secret key for security.

methods.name: insertOrganizationInfo
methods.description: Inserts organization info into the database from stored state.

methods.name: insertSubunitOrganizationName
methods.description: Updates subunit name in database with organization name.

methods.name: setDefaultLanguage
methods.description: Sets default language configuration.

methods.name: insertAdminEmployee
methods.description: Inserts an admin employee record into the database.

methods.name: insertAdminUser
methods.description: Creates an admin user account with hashed password.

methods.name: updateUniqueIdForAdminEmployeeInsertion
methods.description: Updates the unique ID for admin employee insertion.

methods.name: insertInstanceIdentifier
methods.description: Creates or inserts a unique instance identifier for the system.

methods.name: getInstanceIdentifier
methods.description: Generates a system instance identifier from collected data.

methods.name: getInstanceIdentifierData
methods.description: Compiles data used to generate a system instance identifier.

methods.name: createDBUser
methods.description: Creates database users with specific privileges.

methods.name: getUserCreationQueries
methods.description: Generates SQL statements for creating database users and granting privileges.

methods.name: writeConfFile
methods.description: Writes database configuration parameters to a PHP config file.

methods.name: writeKeyFile
methods.description: Generates and writes an encryption key file.

methods.name: getVersionsInRange
methods.description: Provides a list of migration versions in the specified range.

methods.name: runMigrations
methods.description: Executes migrations over a version range.

methods.name: runMigrationFor
methods.description: Runs migration for a specific version.

methods.name: throwMigrationErrorIfPreviousIncomplete
methods.description: Throws exception if previous migration was incomplete.

methods.name: _runMigration
methods.description: Executes a migration class's up() method and handles migration state.

methods.name: disableExecutionTimeLimit
methods.description: Removes PHP script time limit to allow long migration runs.

methods.name: getCurrentProductVersionFromDatabase
methods.description: Fetches current product version stored in database.

methods.name: cleanUpInstallOnFailure
methods.description: Drops all tables to clean up a failed installation.

methods.name: dropDatabase
methods.description: Drops the specified database.
